design_requirements: Frozen prospective spec written and hashed BEFORE any execution (no peeking at per-symbol results before freeze)
Reuse existing accepted 13w M5 dataset; zero new provider/broker calls
One-sided test per symbol with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05, split by chronological half for stability, mirroring the epoch35 precedent pattern
No symbol selection or subsetting based on any prior epoch's observed p-values or supported/near-supported status
Non-economic only: no candidate identity creation, no economic promotion, no protected-forward reads
decision.expected_output: A new EPOCH36_MEAN_REVERSION_MAGNITUDE_PERSISTENCE frontier freeze + deterministic screen + structural result artifact, non-economic, family remains open regardless of outcome.
decision.hypothesis: Reversion-magnitude persistence: after an extreme rolling z-score deviation on M5 bars, test whether the unsigned magnitude of subsequent price reversion toward the rolling mean is stochastically larger than a null (median split by chronological half), independent of directional sign — distinct from epoch25's signed continuation/reversal count statistic.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Author a new frontier freeze spec (research_v3/EPOCH36_MEAN_REVERSION_MAGNITUDE_PERSISTENCE_FRONTIER_FREEZE_V1.json) and a new deterministic screen script (research_v3/mean_reversion_magnitude_epoch36_screen.py) analogous in structure to research_v3/breakout_unsigned_volatility_epoch35_screen.py, operating over the existing accepted 13w M5 development dataset for all 41 frozen structural representatives, then produce evidence/EPOCH36_MEAN_REVERSION_MAGNITUDE_PERSISTENCE_STRUCTURAL_RESULT_V1.json. This is genuinely novel repository machinery (new statistic, new script, new freeze) not reducible to any existing deterministic operation.

objective.goal: Design and freeze a genuinely fresh, prospectively-justified MEAN_REVERSION hypothesis (unsigned reversion-magnitude persistence, distinct from the epoch25 directional continuation/reversal statistic) across the full 41-representative frozen structural panel, to determine whether any symbol exhibits a legally promotable reversion structure before any economic panel is considered.
objective.information_gain_rationale: Epoch35 confirms BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION (blocked) still shows 0/33 supported after a distinct unsigned-magnitude redesign, closing the loop on that family's second angle. Of the remaining unblocked families (TREND_MOMENTUM epoch24, MEAN_REVERSION epoch25, CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING epoch26, REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED epoch29/33/34), REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED has already been probed three times (full-41, a 12-symbol subset, and a composite causal-ML variant) and further work there risks appearing as reparameterization after observed outcomes. MEAN_REVERSION has had exactly one frozen non-economic screen (directional continuation-vs-reversal sign test, 0/41 supported, not closed) and has never been retested with a structurally distinct statistic. Testing reversion MAGNITUDE persistence (analogous in kind to the just-accepted epoch35 unsigned-volatility redesign for breakout) is a genuinely new, outcome-independent hypothesis reusing only already-captured 13w M5 data, maximizing information gain without violating the no-rerun/no-retroactive-tuning prohibitions.
